source_name: Virginia General District Court Online Case Information System (unlawful detainers)
verification_note: URL confirmed during Richmond-phase searches; the system is statewide and covers every Hampton Roads GDC (Norfolk, Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Newport News, Hampton, Portsmouth, Suffolk selected individually).
terms_notes: Per-court selection; search by name/case number/hearing date; no API or bulk export; scraping fragile. Virginia has no rent control/just-cause rules; evictions = unlawful detainer in GDC. Self-help: https://selfhelp.vacourts.gov/page/10/landlord-tenant (search-confirmed).
difficulty_reason: Free but per-court HTML with no API.
notes: Hampton Roads courts historically have among the nation's highest eviction filing rates (Princeton Eviction Lab flagged Norfolk/Newport News/Hampton) — worth a demand-risk note in underwrites; Eviction Lab dataset itself unverified this session.
